label: Membership in next-window top-5 qualified programme IDs; never outer validation labels
features: Log and per-user normalized component scores; recency; program and user history; past/future supply; horizon. No raw user/item identifiers or future metadata.
candidate_pool: Same legal pool as baseline. Candidate generation is the union of documented top-k lists, then reranking; ungenerated items have zero score and common popularity fallback.
selection: Mean of three historical outer MAP@5 values, all variants retained
